prompt: The MS below shows M⁺ at m/z 58 and a strong base peak at m/z 43 (M−15). Which compound matches?
explanation: M = 58 fits C3H6O (acetone or propanal). Loss of 15 (methyl) with 43 as base peak is characteristic of acetone's α-cleavage: [CH3-CO]+ acylium ion. Propanal would lose H (29 = CHO) more strongly. Butane has M+ 58 but fragments differently (no acylium pathway).
